pages.text: Raw uranium and yellorium, yellorite ore, plutonium and polonium pellets, yellow cake and fuel rods give off radiation from an ordinary chest, through walls. A full chest of raw uranium reaches about eighteen blocks.$(br2)Nothing in a $(item)Lead-Lined Chest$() gives off radiation, however much is in it.

Two side by side join into a large chest. Hoppers and pipes reach it from any side, comparators read it, and breaking it spills what is inside.$(br2)The light on the lid glows green while it is shut and amber while it is open, and its screen carries a green $(l)SHIELDED$() tag.
pages.title: A chest like any other

pages.text: Eight lead plates round a wooden chest. Any mod's lead plates will do.
